subject: Action Required: Missing Purchase Order for Payment PAY-999
body:
Dear Globex Team,

We have received your payment (PAY-999) for $15,000.00 intended to cover Invoice INV-5002.

However, per Section 4.2 of our Master Service Agreement, any invoice exceeding $10,000.00 strictly requires a valid Purchase Order (PO) number. Since no PO number was provided with this remittance, we are required to hold the payment until one is supplied.

Please reply to this email with the valid PO number so we can process your payment and apply it to your account balance.

Thank you,
Accounts Receivable
